description: No mechanism exists for data subjects to obtain human intervention, express their point of view, or contest automated decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects.
applicability: Applicable when automated decision-making is permitted under Article 22.2 exceptions. Safeguards must include human intervention capability.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of automated decision systems and appeal/review mechanisms. Verify human review process exists and is accessible.

sources.title: GDPR - Regulation (EU) 2016/679
sources.section: Chapter III - Rights of the Data Subject
